contract.level_processing: Unnormalized source capture; recorded commands, raw WAV values and CSV measurements matched

producer_attempt_policy: Each exact uploaded artifact ID/name/size is bound to the original producer log and raw job API run_attempt. Installation manifests contain source/run, not a run-attempt field. Original timestamps and the explicit two-second upload-step precision allowance are retained.
acquisition_and_offline_check_history: Apple Silicon validator acquisition used a hash-verified versioned-release fallback after one API transfer rejection. That was not a product validation retry.
The first ARM local bundle-check invocation stopped because its working directory had not been created; the unchanged checker then passed.

The first Linux offline install check rejected the actual transient overall queued status after native completion. A fresh real in-progress API snapshot passed the same unchanged checker and archive. Both invocations/snapshots are retained; no CI job or validator was rerun.

historical_outcomes.scope: Four Linux fixture failures and two Intel timeouts remain failures of that source; no retry of that run was executed.
Earlier Apple Silicon AU GUI graphics abort remains preserved; current fixed-seed success is a new execution.
Earlier post-SUCCESS Linux SIGSEGV remains unexplained; current normal exits do not establish its cause or a permanent fix.

limits: These are retained CI installation bundles without publisher release signing or Apple notarization; macOS build tools may attach ad-hoc signatures. They are not universal Mac binaries or permanent release assets.
Windows pluginval covers two headless invocations; Mac and Linux GUI scopes are listed per lane. Optional external Steinberg validator paths remain unset as recorded in original logs.
Core sanitizer coverage does not instrument the packaged plugin wrappers/GUI, and its unavailable nested Python counts remain unknown.
Numerical and signal-role checks plus selected actual auditions do not establish exact acoustic-instrument realism, calibrated physical CS-80 equivalence or a subjective listening-panel judgment.
Arbitrary DAWs, audio devices, controller/chord histories and complete release tails are not certified. The previously recorded VST3 Program-queue controller dependency remains.
Earlier per-platform snapshots intentionally preserve in-progress/queued overall states. This final aggregate records the later completed successful run without rewriting those snapshots.
Later screenshot/documentation commits do not identify different binary bytes; the full source SHA above remains the build identity.
